title: The Generalized Random Access Problem for Linear Codes
summary: Random access is a central requirement in DNA-based storage systems: one would like to recover selected information symbols without sequencing the whole encoded object. A recent combinatorial model associates to a generator matrix $G\in F_q^{k\times n}$ the random variable $τ_i(G)$, measuring the number of sampled columns needed to recover the information vector $e_i$. We study the cardinality-based extremal and finite-geometric aspects of simultaneous multi-symbol recovery.
